# Lights Out Puzzle

A fully offline, 3x3 Lights Out puzzle built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No packages, no network requests, no external assets.

## How to play

- Click (or focus and press Enter/Space on) any cell to toggle it and its up, down, left and right neighbours.
- The move counter tracks your clicks.
- Turn every light off to win.
- Press **New Puzzle** at any time to scramble a fresh, always-solvable board.

## Run

Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Features

- 3x3 grid with orthogonal neighbour toggling
- Move counter and win message (announced via ARIA live region)
- Randomly scrambled but guaranteed-solvable puzzles
- Keyboard accessible controls with visible hover, focus and pressed states
- Responsive centered card layout that works from 360px wide

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `style.css` — theme, layout and control states
- `script.js` — game logic and rendering
